name: Pak Solutions
old_description: STEB’s are utilized in duty fee shop across the globe and are manufactured under the ICAO (International Civilian Airline Organization) guidelines. PAK Solutions is recognized as an approved manufacturer of this product.
about:
Pak Solutions operates from Lancaster, New Hampshire, where it has produced tamper-evident and specialty packaging since at least 2018. In June 2018 the business was acquired by an ownership group of professionals with deep ties to the New England region, giving the company new direction.

The company manufactures a range of security and packaging products including STEB duty-free bags, security deposit bags, vault bags, patient valuables bags, and glue-seal evidence bags. It also serves medical, food, e-commerce, and specialty packaging markets. Production capabilities center on flexo solvent printing and laminating, supported by an in-house graphics department for rapid artwork turnaround. A $7 million expansion announced in May 2020 added two flexo solvent presses, including a 2020 Koenig & Bauer press, to increase capacity.

Customers span healthcare facilities requiring sterile packaging, airlines and duty-free retailers using ICAO-compliant STEBs, food processors, e-commerce shippers, and law-enforcement agencies needing evidence-handling bags. The firm positions itself as a single-source supplier for tamper-evident and security packaging across these sectors.

Management emphasizes its status as a leader in tamper-evident packaging, backed by continuous equipment investment and an internal graphics team that shortens lead times on custom work. The ICAO approval for STEB production underscores its ability to meet stringent international standards.
